en.t: After the death of Anastasius II, Symmachus is elected Pope in the Lateran Palace, while Laurentius is elected Pope in Santa Maria Maggiore
en.s: The Apostolic Palace of the Lateran (Latin: Palatium Apostolicum Lateranense), informally the Lateran Palace (Latin: Palatium Lateranense; Italian: Palazzo del Laterano), is an ancient palace of the Roman Empire and later the main papal residence in Rome. Located on Saint John's Square in Lateran on the Caelian Hill, the palace is adjacent to the Archbasilica of Saint John Lateran, the cathedral church of Rome.

zh.t: 阿纳斯塔修斯二世去世后，西玛库斯在拉特朗宫当选教皇，劳伦提乌斯则在圣母大殿当选教皇
zh.s: 拉特朗宗座宫（拉丁语：Palatium Apostolicum Lateranense），俗称拉特朗宫（拉丁语：Palatium Lateranense；意大利语：Palazzo del Laterano），是古罗马帝国时期建造的宫殿，后来成为罗马教皇的主要住所。宫殿位于凯利安山拉特朗的圣若望广场，毗邻罗马主教座堂圣若望拉特朗大殿。

en.s: The Battle of Ballon took place on 22 November 845 between the forces of Charles the Bald, king of West Francia, and Nominoë, Duke of Brittany. Nominoë was appropriating border territory and opposing Charles' attempt to impose Frankish authority. Nominoë defeated Charles, initiating a period of Breton expansion and consolidation of power.

zh.s: 845年11月22日，西法兰克国王秃头查理的军队与布列塔尼公爵诺米诺埃的军队在巴隆交战。诺米诺埃当时正夺取边境领土，并反对查理试图确立法兰克统治。诺米诺埃击败了查理，此后布列塔尼的势力一度扩张并巩固。

en.t: Pope Honorius III crowns Frederick II Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: On November 22, 1220, Pope Honorius III crowned Frederick II Holy Roman Emperor at St. Peter's Basilica in Rome. Frederick had already been king of Germany and Sicily. The ceremony gave him the imperial title; contemporary chronicles also record the coronation of his wife Constance as empress that day.
en.n: The imperial coronation took place in Rome on November 22, 1220.

zh.t: 教宗何诺三世为腓特烈二世加冕
zh.s: 1220年11月22日，教宗何诺三世在罗马圣彼得大殿为腓特烈二世加冕，使他正式获得神圣罗马帝国皇帝称号。腓特烈此前已是德意志和西西里国王。当时的编年史还记载，他的妻子康斯坦丝也在同一天加冕为皇后。
zh.n: 皇帝加冕礼于1220年11月22日在罗马举行。

en.t: Spanish navigator Juan Fernández discovers islands now known as the Juan Fernández Islands off Chile
en.s: Juan Fernández (c. 1536 – c. 1604) was a Spanish explorer and navigator in the Pacific regions of the Viceroyalty of Peru and Captaincy General of Chile west of colonial South America. He is best known for the discovery of a fast maritime route from Callao (Peru) to Valparaíso (Chile) as well as for the discovery of the Juan Fernández Islands off the coast of Chile.

zh.t: 西班牙航海家胡安·费尔南德斯发现智利外海现称胡安·费尔南德斯群岛的岛屿
zh.s: 胡安·费尔南德斯（约1536年—约1604年）是西班牙探险家和航海家，曾在秘鲁总督辖区和智利都督辖区所属的南美洲西部太平洋地区活动。他因发现卡亚俄（秘鲁）至瓦尔帕莱索（智利）的快速海上航线，以及发现智利海岸外的胡安·费尔南德斯群岛而闻名。

en.s: The Battle of San Juan (1595) was a Spanish victory during the Anglo–Spanish War. This war broke out in 1585 and was fought not only in the European theatre but in Spain's American colonies. After emerging from six years of disgrace following the resounding defeat of the English Armada at Lisbon in 1589, Francis Drake embarked on a long and disastrous campaign against the Spanish Main, suffering several consecutive defeats there. On 22 November 1595 Drake and John Hawkins tried to invade San Juan, Puerto Rico with 27 ships and 2,500 men.

zh.s: 圣胡安战役是英西战争期间西班牙的一场胜利。这场战争于1585年爆发，战场不仅在欧洲，也包括西班牙在美洲的殖民地。1589年英国无敌舰队在里斯本遭到惨败后，弗朗西斯·德雷克经历6年失意，随后对西属美洲大陆展开一场漫长而惨败的远征，接连失利。1595年11月22日，德雷克和约翰·霍金斯率领27艘船、2,500名士兵，试图进攻波多黎各圣胡安。

en.s: The Battle of Ragusa was a naval engagement in 1617 between Francisco de Ribera from the Spanish Viceroyalty of Naples and Lorenzo Venier of the Republic of Venice. It resulted in a Spanish and Neapolitan victory.

zh.s: 1617年，来自西班牙统治下那不勒斯总督区的弗朗西斯科·德·里贝拉与威尼斯共和国的洛伦佐·维涅尔在海上交战。西班牙和那不勒斯联军获胜。

en.s: A series of military actions and diplomatic moves were undertaken in 1635 and 1636 by the United East India Company (VOC) in Dutch-era Taiwan (Formosa) aimed at subduing hostile aboriginal villages in the southwestern region of the island. Prior to the campaign, the Dutch had been in Formosa for eleven years, but did not control much of the island beyond their principal fortress at Tayouan (present-day Anping, Tainan), and an alliance with the town of Sinkan.

zh.t: 1635年荷兰东印度公司在台湾的军事行动开始
zh.s: 1635年11月22日，荷兰东印度公司在台湾西南部展开军事和外交行动，试图控制当地与其对立的原住民村落。此前荷兰人在台湾已驻留约11年，但实际控制范围主要仍在大员的据点周围。这一系列行动延续到1636年。

en.s: The assault on Brussels or siege of Brussels occurred during the War of the Spanish Succession, from 22 to 27 November 1708 involving French and pro-Bourbon Spanish troops under Maximilian of Bavaria against the garrison and citizens of the city of Brussels. While the army of the Grand Alliance was occupied with the Siege of Lille, the Elector of Bavaria, Maximilian, made an attempt to capture Brussels.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争期间，马克西米利安率领的法国和亲波旁王朝的西班牙军队于1708年11月22日至27日围攻布鲁塞尔。此前，大同盟军正忙于围攻里尔，巴伐利亚选侯马克西米利安趁机试图攻占布鲁塞尔。守军和市民抵抗围城部队。

en.s: The Battle of Breslau (also known as the Battle on the Lohe) was fought on 22 November 1757 in Breslau (now Wrocław, Poland) during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). A Prussian army of 28,000 men fought an Austrian army of 60,000 men. The Prussians held off the Austrian attack, losing 6,000 men to the Austrians' 5,000 men.

zh.s: 1757年11月22日，布雷斯劳战役也称洛赫河战役，在第三次西里西亚战争期间于布雷斯劳（今波兰弗罗茨瓦夫）爆发。28,000名普鲁士军队与60,000名奥地利军队交战。普军挡住奥军进攻，伤亡6,000人；奥军伤亡5,000人。

en.s: The Raid on Canso took place on 22 September–22 November 1776 during the American Revolutionary War. The raid involved American Continental Navy Captain John Paul Jones attacking Canso, Nova Scotia, and the surrounding fishing villages.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 坎索突袭发生于1776年9月22日至11月22日，是美国独立战争期间的一次袭击。美国大陆海军约翰·保罗·琼斯上尉袭击了新斯科舍省坎索及周边渔村。

en.s: The 1783 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 22, 1783, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Governor William Paca was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1783年11月22日举行州长选举。现任州长威廉·帕卡没有对手，由州议会轻松选举连任。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The 1787 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 22, 1787, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Governor William Smallwood was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1787年11月22日举行州长选举。现任州长威廉·斯莫尔伍德没有对手，由州议会轻松选举连任。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The Battle of Dol was a succession of battles in the war in the Vendée. They lasted three days and two nights from 20 to 22 November 1793 around Dol-de-Bretagne, Pontorson and Antrain. The Vendéens repelled an offensive by the Republicans against the town of Dol-de-Bretagne, then counterattacked and stormed Antrain, where the patriots' headquarters were located.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 旺代战争期间，多勒附近于1793年11月20日至22日发生了一连串战斗，持续3天2夜。旺代军击退了共和军对多勒德布列塔尼的进攻，随后反攻并攻占了爱国者总部所在的安特兰。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Luxembourg was a siege by France of the Habsburg-held Fortress of Luxembourg that lasted from 1794 until 7 June 1795, during the French Revolutionary Wars. Although the French army failed to breach the walls of the city, which were renowned as amongst the best in the world, the fortress was forced to surrender after more than seven months.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1794至1795年，法国围攻由哈布斯堡王朝控制的卢森堡要塞。围城持续到1795年6月7日。尽管法国军队未能攻破城墙，历时七个多月后，要塞还是被迫投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的围城开始日期。

en.s: The 1799 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 22, 1799, in order to elect the Governor of North Carolina. Federalist candidate Benjamin Williams was elected by the North Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1799年11月22日举行州长选举。联邦党候选人本杰明·威廉姆斯没有对手，由州议会选举当选。此次选举的确切票数不详。

en.s: In the siege of Hamelin or siege of Hameln (7 November 1806–22 November 1806), First French Empire forces captured the fortress of Hamelin from its garrison composed of troops from the Kingdom of Prussia. The siege was begun by the VIII Corps under French Marshal Édouard Adolphe Casimir Joseph Mortier. The marshal initially left General of Division Jean-Baptiste Dumonceau in charge of operations.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1806年11月7日至22日，法兰西第一帝国军队围攻哈默尔恩，并从普鲁士王国守军手中攻占要塞。法国元帅爱德华·莫蒂埃率第八军团发起围城行动，最初由师级将军让-巴蒂斯特·杜蒙索负责指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of French Mills or First Salmon River Raid was a raid and battle fought on November 22, 1812. 100 American soldiers stationed at French Mills led a successful attack against 45 Canadian voyageurs on 23 October at the Battle of St. Regis. Half returned to French Mills while the other half departed for Plattsburgh, New York.

zh.s: 法兰西磨坊战役又称第一次萨蒙河袭击战，是1812年11月22日发生的一次袭击和战斗。驻扎在法兰西磨坊的100名美国士兵于10月23日在圣雷吉斯战役中成功袭击了45名加拿大航运工。此后，一半人员返回法兰西磨坊，另一半前往纽约州普拉茨堡。

en.s: The Battle of Wild Cat Creek was the result of a November 1812 punitive expedition against Native American villages during the War of 1812. It has been nicknamed "Spur's Defeat", which is thought to refer to the spurs used by the soldiers to drive their horses away from the battle as quickly as possible. The campaign is sometimes referred to as the Second Battle of Tippecanoe.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1812年11月的一次惩罚性远征引发了野猫溪战役。该战役也称“马刺败战”，人们认为这个绰号源自士兵用马刺驱马，尽快逃离战场。这场战役有时也被称为第二次蒂珀卡努战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的战役结束日期。

en.s: The First Battle of Huachi was the second battle in the Ecuadorian War of Independence, that took place on 22 November 1820 near Ambato, Ecuador. The battle was fought between Royalist soldiers in support of the Spanish Empire, and the Patriot forces of the Free Province of Guayaquil, who suffered a serious defeat.

zh.s: 第一次瓦奇战役是厄瓜多尔独立战争中的第二场战斗，于1820年11月22日在厄瓜多尔安巴托附近爆发。支持西班牙帝国的保王党军队与瓜亚基尔自由省的爱国者军队交战，后者遭到惨败。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 22 November 1822. The elections were the only vote held under the 1822 constitution, which provided for a unicameral legislature.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1822年11月22日举行议会选举。这是根据1822年宪法举行的唯一一次选举，该宪法规定设立一院制议会。

en.t: Canadian journalist and politician William Lyon Mackenzie calls for a rebellion against the United Kingdom in his essay "To the People of Upper Canada", published in his newspaper The Constitution
en.s: The Province of Upper Canada (French: province du Haut-Canada) was one of the two Provinces of The Canadas established in 1791 by the Kingdom of Great Britain to govern the central portion of the lands in British North America, formerly part of the Province of Quebec since 1763.

zh.t: 加拿大记者和政治家威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐在其报纸《宪法报》发表《致上加拿大人民》，呼吁反抗英国
zh.s: 上加拿大省（法语：province du Haut-Canada）是1791年大不列颠王国设立的加拿大两省之一，负责治理英属北美中部地区；该地区自1763年以来原属魁北克省。

en.s: The Battle of Ramnagar (sometimes referred to as the Battle of Rumnuggur) was fought on 22 November 1848 between the forces of the British Empire (including the British East India Company) and the Sikh Empire during the Second Anglo-Sikh War. The British were led by Sir Hugh Gough, while the Sikhs were led by Raja Sher Singh Attariwalla. The Sikhs repelled an attempted British surprise attack.

zh.s: 1848年11月22日，英国帝国军队（包括英国东印度公司部队）与锡克帝国军队在第二次英锡战争期间爆发拉姆纳加尔战役。休·高夫爵士率领英军，拉贾·谢尔·辛格·阿塔里瓦拉率领锡克军。锡克军击退了英军的突袭。

en.s: The Battle of Camp Davies was a skirmish during the American Civil War on November 22, 1863, near a Union Army camp about six miles south of Corinth, Mississippi. A 70-man detachment of the 1st Regiment Alabama Cavalry (Union), commanded by Major Francis L. Cramer, drove off a 150-man Confederate force of the 16th Battalion, Mississippi Cavalry State Troops (sometimes referred to as 1st Battalion or simply as Ham's Battalion of Cavalry), commanded by Major Thomas W.

zh.s: 戴维斯营战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模交战，发生于1863年11月22日，地点在密西西比州科林斯以南约6英里的一处联邦军营附近。弗朗西斯·L·克莱默少校率领70名联邦军第一阿拉巴马骑兵团士兵，击退了托马斯·W少校指挥的150名邦联军第16密西西比州骑兵营士兵（有时称第一营或哈姆骑兵营）。

en.s: The 1864–65 New South Wales colonial election was held between 22 November 1864 and 10 January 1865. This election was for all of the 72 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 52 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.s: 1864年11月22日至1865年1月10日，新南威尔士殖民地举行选举，改选立法议会全部72个席位。选区包括52个单议席选区、6个双议席选区和2个四议席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: The Battle of Griswoldville was the first battle of Sherman's March to the Sea, fought November 22, 1864, during the American Civil War. A Union Army brigade under Brig. Gen. Charles C. Walcutt fought three brigades of Georgia militia under Brig. Gen. Pleasant J. Philips, at Griswoldville (an industrial town), near Macon, Georgia, and continued its march toward Savannah.

zh.t: 格里斯沃尔德维尔战役
zh.s: 格里斯沃尔德维尔战役是谢尔曼向海进军的首场战斗，于1864年11月22日在美国内战期间爆发。查尔斯·C·沃尔卡特准将率领一支联邦军旅，与普莱森特·J·菲利普斯准将指挥的佐治亚民兵3个旅在格里斯沃尔德维尔交战。格里斯沃尔德维尔当时是一个工业城镇，位于佐治亚州梅肯附近。之后联邦军继续向萨凡纳进军。

en.s: The siege of Salto occurred during the Uruguayan War, from the 22nd to the 28th of November 1864, when Brazilian forces (under Marquis of Tamandaré) and Colorado forces (under Venancio Flores) attempted to capture the city of Salto in Uruguay from its Uruguayan Army defenders. Two Brazilian gunboats under First Lieutenant Joaquim José Pinto blockaded the town. On 24 November, Flores arrived with his troops and began the siege.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乌拉圭战争期间，巴西军队和科罗拉多党军队于1864年11月22日至28日围攻乌拉圭城市萨尔托。巴西军队由塔曼达雷侯爵指挥，科罗拉多党军队由维南西奥·弗洛雷斯率领，守军是乌拉圭军队。巴西两艘炮艇由海军少尉若阿金·若泽·平托指挥，封锁了该城。11月24日，弗洛雷斯率军抵达并开始围城。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The French Intervention to Korea (French: Expédition française en Corée, Korean: 병인양요) was an 1866 punitive expedition undertaken by the Second French Empire against Joseon Korea in retaliation for the execution of seven French Catholic missionaries. The encounter over Ganghwa Island lasted nearly six weeks. The result was an eventual French retreat, and a check on French influence in the region.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1866年，法兰西第二帝国为报复朝鲜王朝处决7名法国天主教传教士而出兵。江华岛交战持续近6周，最终法军撤退，法国在当地的影响力也受到遏制。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的远征结束日期。

en.t: Tea clipper Cutty Sark is launched in Dumbarton
en.s: On November 22, 1869, the tea clipper Cutty Sark was launched at Dumbarton, Scotland. Built for shipowner John Willis for the China tea trade, she was named by the wife of her first captain, George Moodie. Her maiden voyage began the following year; the ship is now preserved at Greenwich, London.
en.n: The November 22 event was the ship's launch; her maiden voyage came in 1870.

zh.t: 茶叶快帆船“卡蒂萨克号”在苏格兰下水
zh.s: 1869年11月22日，茶叶快帆船“卡蒂萨克号”在苏格兰敦巴顿下水。这艘船由船东约翰·威利斯为中国茶叶贸易建造，首任船长乔治·穆迪的妻子为它命名。它到次年才开始首航，如今保存于伦敦格林尼治。
zh.n: 11月22日是下水日；首航发生在1870年。

en.t: Steamship Ville du Havre sinks after Atlantic collision
en.s: In the early hours of November 22, 1873, the French steamship Ville du Havre collided with the British sailing ship Loch Earn in the North Atlantic. Ville du Havre sank within about 12 minutes, and 226 passengers and crew died. Survivors were rescued by Loch Earn and another vessel, Tremountain.
en.n: The collision and sinking took place at sea on November 22, 1873.

zh.t: “阿弗尔城号”汽船在大西洋相撞后沉没
zh.s: 1873年11月22日凌晨，法国汽船“阿弗尔城号”（Ville du Havre）在北大西洋与英国帆船“洛赫恩号”（Loch Earn）相撞，约12分钟后沉没，226名乘客和船员遇难。幸存者由“洛赫恩号”和另一艘船Tremountain号救起。
zh.n: 两船相撞及沉没发生于1873年11月22日的海上。

en.s: During the implementation of the Congress of Berlin, when the Principality of Montenegro had received Plav and Gusinje (along with other places), the surrounding Albanian populace under the guise of the Ottomans attacked the Montenegrin forces in Velika at two occasions, on October 9 and November 22, 1879. The Albanians were defeated.

zh.s: 柏林会议实施期间，黑山公国获得普拉夫、古西涅等地。当地阿尔巴尼亚居民以奥斯曼人名义，两次袭击韦利卡的黑山军队，时间分别是1879年10月9日和11月22日。阿尔巴尼亚人被击败。

en.s: The Battle of Ulcinj took place between the Ottoman forces of Dervish Pasha and Albanian irregulars in the year of 1880 at the region of Kodre, close to Gornja Klezna. The area of Plav and Gusinje had been ceded to the Principality of Montenegro, according to the decisions of the Treaty of Berlin (1878), but the Albanians fought against the annexation.

zh.s: 1880年，德尔维什帕夏率领的奥斯曼军队与阿尔巴尼亚非正规部队在戈尔尼亚克莱兹纳附近的科德雷地区交战。根据1878年《柏林条约》，普拉夫和古西涅地区被割让给黑山公国，但阿尔巴尼亚人反对这一吞并。

en.s: The 1885 Nepal coup d'état (Nepali: ४२ सालको पर्व) was a coup d'état led by Khadga Shumsher, Bhim Shumsher, Bir Shumsher, and Dambar Shumsher on 22 November 1885.

zh.s: 1885年11月22日，卡德加·舒姆谢尔、比姆·舒姆谢尔、比尔·舒姆谢尔和丹巴尔·舒姆谢尔领导发动政变。尼泊尔语称这次政变为“42 सालको पर्व”。

en.s: The Congress of Manastir (Albanian: Kongresi i Manastirit) was a national conference held in the city of Manastir (now Bitola) from November 14 to 22, 1908, with the goal of standardizing the Albanian alphabet. November 22 is now a commemorative day in Albania, Kosovo, and North Macedonia as well as among the Albanian diaspora known as Alphabet Day (Albanian: Dita e Alfabetit).
en.n: The Congress of Manastir establishes the Albanian alphabet.

zh.s: 马纳斯蒂尔大会是1908年11月14日至22日在马纳斯蒂尔（今北马其顿比托拉）举行的一次全国会议，目标是统一阿尔巴尼亚字母。11月22日如今在阿尔巴尼亚、科索沃、北马其顿及阿尔巴尼亚侨民中被纪念为字母日（阿尔巴尼亚语：Dita e Alfabetit）。
zh.n: 马纳斯蒂尔大会确立了阿尔巴尼亚字母。

en.s: The First Battle of Ypres (French: Première Bataille des Flandres, German: Erste Flandernschlacht, 19 October – 22 November 1914) was a battle of the First World War, fought on the Western Front around Ypres, in West Flanders, Belgium. The battle was part of the First Battle of Flanders, in which German, French, Belgian armies and the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) fought from Arras in France to Nieuwpoort (Nieuport) on the Belgian coast, from 10 October to mid-November.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次伊普尔战役于1914年10月19日至11月22日发生在比利时西佛兰德省伊普尔周边的西线战场，是第一次世界大战中的一场战役。它属于第一次佛兰德战役的一部分；在这场更广泛的战役中，德国、法国、比利时军队和英国远征军，从10月10日至11月中旬，在法国阿拉斯至比利时海岸纽波特一线作战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Krivolak (in Bulgarian: Криволашко сражение, Битка при Криволак) was a World War I battle, fought between 21 October and 22 November 1915. It was fought in the initial stage of the Macedonian campaign, in the Balkans Theatre. On 21 October, Bulgarian troops attacked the French-held positions near the Strumica rail station, at the time part of the Kingdom of Serbia (present-day North Macedonia), starting the battle.

zh.s: 克里沃拉克战役是第一次世界大战中的一场战斗，于1915年10月21日至11月22日在巴尔干战场的马其顿战役初期进行。10月21日，保加利亚军队袭击了斯特鲁米察铁路站附近的法军阵地；当时该地属于塞尔维亚王国（今北马其顿），战役由此开始。

en.s: The Battle of Ctesiphon (Turkish: Selman-ı Pak Muharebesi) was fought in November 1915 by the British Empire, against the Ottoman Empire, within the Mesopotamian Campaign of World War I. Indian Expeditionary Force D, mostly made up of Indian units and under the command of Gen. Sir John Nixon, had met with success in Ottoman Iraq since it had landed at Al-Faw Peninsula upon the Ottoman Empire's declaration of war on 5 November 1914.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克特西丰战役于1915年11月爆发，是第一次世界大战美索不达米亚战役的一部分，交战双方为大英帝国和奥斯曼帝国。英属印度远征军D部队主要由印度部队组成，由约翰·尼克松将军指挥；自1914年11月5日奥斯曼帝国参战、该部队在法奥半岛登陆以来，它在奥斯曼伊拉克战场上进展顺利。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的战役开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Radviliškis (Lithuanian: Radviliškio kautynės) was fought between the Lithuanian Armed Forces and the Western Russian Volunteer Army, also known as Bermontians, a pro-German military formation, commanded by Pavel Bermondt-Avalov near the city of Radviliškis as part of the Lithuanian Wars of Independence. Fought on 21–22 November 1919, it saw the decisive defeat of the Bermontians and their subsequent retreat from the Baltic States.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 立陶宛军队于1919年11月21日至22日在拉德维利什基斯附近与西俄罗斯志愿军交战。西俄罗斯志愿军也称“贝尔蒙特军”，是一支亲德部队，由帕维尔·贝尔蒙特-阿瓦洛夫指挥。战斗是立陶宛独立战争的一部分，贝尔蒙特军遭到决定性击败，随后撤出波罗的海国家。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Paddy Webb wins Buller parliamentary by-election
en.s: On November 22, 1933, voters in New Zealand's Buller electorate chose Labour candidate Paddy Webb in a parliamentary by-election. The seat was vacant after the death of Harry Holland, Labour's leader and the parliamentary opposition leader. Webb defeated Liberal-Labour candidate H. Ian Simson.
en.n: Voting in the Buller by-election took place on November 22, 1933.

zh.t: 帕迪·韦布赢得新西兰布勒选区补选
zh.s: 1933年11月22日，新西兰布勒选区举行议会补选，工党候选人帕迪·韦布当选。原议员哈里·霍兰德去世后，留下了这个席位；他生前也是工党及议会反对派领袖。韦布击败了自由工党候选人H. 伊恩·辛普森。
zh.n: 布勒选区补选于1933年11月22日投票。

en.s: The 1933 Calgary municipal election was held on November 22, 1933 to elect a Mayor and six Aldermen to sit on Calgary City Council. Along with positions on Calgary City Council, a Commissioner, three trustees for the Public School Board, and two trustees for the Separate School Board. Calgary City Council governed under "Initiative, Referendum and Recall" which is composed of a Mayor, Commissioner and twelve Aldermen all elected to staggered two year terms.

zh.s: 卡尔加里于1933年11月22日举行市政选举，选出市长和6名市议员。此外，选民还选出一名专员、3名公立学校董事会成员和2名独立学校董事会成员。当时卡尔加里市议会实行“倡议权、公民投票权和罢免权”制度，由市长、专员和12名市议员组成，任期交错，每两年改选。

en.t: The China Clipper inaugurates the first commercial transpacific air service, connecting Alameda, California with Manila
en.s: China Clipper (NC14716) was the first of three Martin M-130 four-engine flying boats built for Pan American Airways and was used to inaugurate the first commercial transpacific airmail service from San Francisco to Manila on November 22, 1935. Built at a cost of $417,000 by the Glenn L. Martin Company in Baltimore, Maryland, it was delivered to Pan Am on October 9, 1935.

zh.t: 中国飞剪号开通首条跨太平洋商业航线
zh.s: 中国飞剪号（编号NC14716）是泛美航空公司订购的3架马丁M-130四引擎飞艇中的第一架。1935年11月22日，它执飞从旧金山到马尼拉的首条跨太平洋商业航空邮政航线。该机由格伦·L·马丁公司在马里兰州巴尔的摩建造，造价417,000美元，并于1935年10月9日交付泛美航空。

en.s: 1939 Taiwanese local elections were held on 22 November 1939, electing half of the city and township councillors for the second time under Japanese rule. The other half were appointed by the prefectural governors. After the authorities highlighting the solemnity and idealness of an election under the current situation, the cities banned door-to-door election campaign and advocated using less publications to reduce waste.

zh.s: 台湾于1939年11月22日举行地方选举，在日本统治下第二次选出各市和街庄议员中的一半，其余一半由州知事任命。当局强调在当前形势下举行选举的庄严性和理想性，随后各市禁止挨家挨户拉票，并提倡减少宣传品以避免浪费。

en.s: The Cochinchina uprising (Vietnamese: Nam Kỳ khởi nghĩa) was an armed peasant uprising against the French colonialists by the Vietnamese in the south (at that time known as Cochinchina) in 1940, led by the Indochinese Communist Party.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1940年，越南南部（当时称交趾支那）发生反抗法国殖民统治的农民武装起义，由印度支那共产党领导。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的起义开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Korçë (Also known as Koritsa/Coriza) was a battle fought during the Greco-Italian War of 1940–41 in the town of Korçë in southern Albania between the defending Italian 9th Army and the attacking Greek III Army Corps. The town had been made the main base of operations for the Italian Air Force. After the initial Italian invasion starting 28 October had been stopped, Greek forces launched a counter-offensive in early November.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科尔察战役是1940至1941年希腊—意大利战争中的一场战斗，发生在阿尔巴尼亚南部的科尔察。意大利第九集团军在此防守，希腊第三军团发起进攻。意大利空军以该镇为主要作战基地。意军于10月28日入侵希腊后被挡住，希腊军队于11月初发动反攻。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的战役结束日期。

en.t: Paulus reports that Germany's Sixth Army is encircled at Stalingrad
en.s: On November 22, 1942, German Sixth Army commander Friedrich Paulus reported by radio that Soviet forces had encircled his troops near Stalingrad. Soviet troops had seized the Don bridge at Kalach that morning, cutting a vital route behind the German army. Paulus's report described the danger as he saw it; the Soviet ring was not yet fully closed and was completed the following day.
en.n: November 22 dates Paulus's report, not the completion of the Soviet encirclement on November 23.

zh.t: 保卢斯报告德军第六集团军在斯大林格勒被围
zh.s: 1942年11月22日，德军第六集团军司令弗里德里希·保卢斯发报称，苏军已在斯大林格勒附近包围他的部队。苏军当天上午夺取了卡拉奇的顿河大桥，切断了德军后方的一条重要通道。保卢斯报告的是当时他所判断的险情；包围圈当时尚未完全闭合，直到次日才合拢。
zh.n: 11月22日是保卢斯发报的日期；苏军在11月23日才完成合围。

en.s: The Dodecanese campaign (8 September – 22 November 1943) was the capture and occupation of the Dodecanese islands by German forces during the Second World War. Following the signing of the Armistice of Cassibile on 3 September 1943, Italy joined the Allies. The Germans implemented contingency plans to seize control of the Dodecanese, which were under Italian control.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 多德卡尼斯群岛战役于1943年9月8日至11月22日进行，是第二次世界大战期间德军对多德卡尼斯群岛的占领行动。1943年9月3日《卡西比莱停战协定》签署后，意大利加入盟军。德国随后实施预案，接管原由意大利控制的多德卡尼斯群岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: First Cairo Conference begins with Roosevelt, Churchill and Chiang Kai-shek
en.s: On November 22, 1943, the First Cairo Conference opened in Egypt during World War II. US President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and China's leader Chiang Kai-shek met to discuss the war against Japan and plans for postwar Asia. Their meetings continued through November 26; the Cairo Declaration was released later.
en.n: The first Cairo meetings began November 22; the declaration was released later.

zh.t: 罗斯福、丘吉尔与蒋介石在开罗开始会谈
zh.s: 1943年11月22日，第二次世界大战期间的第一次开罗会议在埃及开始。美国总统罗斯福、英国首相丘吉尔和中国领导人蒋介石会面，商讨对日作战以及战后亚洲的安排。会谈持续到11月26日，《开罗宣言》则在之后公布。
zh.n: 11月22日开始的是开罗会谈；宣言之后才公布。

en.s: During the Second World War, Operation Clipper was an Allied offensive by the British XXX Corps (which included the American 84th Infantry Division) to reduce the Geilenkirchen salient in mid-November 1944. Clipper was the preliminary to a wider Allied operation, Operation Queen, to gain control of the Roer valley and of the Hürtgen Forest. Geilenkirchen is situated on the Wurm River, some 20 km (12 mi) north of Aachen.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1944年11月中旬，第二次世界大战期间，英国第30军（包括美国第84步兵师）发动剪刀行动，目标是夺取盖伦基兴突出部。该行动为规模更大的“王后行动”做准备，后者旨在控制鲁尔河谷和许特根森林。盖伦基兴位于亚琛以北约20公里处的乌尔姆河畔。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的行动结束日期。

en.s: The Kosovo Operation was a major strategic military offensive launched between 15 October and 22 November 1944 by the Bulgarian 2nd Army, with the assistance of the Yugoslav Partisans and Albanian Partisans, against German forces and local collaborationist auxiliaries in Kosovo. Although the Bulgarian army was the main force which drove the Germans out of the area, subsequent Yugoslav historiography has downplayed its role for political reasons.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 保加利亚第二集团军在南斯拉夫游击队和阿尔巴尼亚游击队协助下，于1944年10月15日至11月22日在科索沃发动大规模战略攻势，打击德军及当地协从部队。保加利亚军队是将德军逐出当地的主力，但此后南斯拉夫史学出于政治原因淡化了保加利亚军队的作用。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Lüliang campaign (吕梁战役), also called Southwestern Shanxi campaign (晋西南战役), was a series of battles fought between the nationalists and the communists in Lüliang region in southwestern Shanxi during the Chinese Civil War in the post World War II era, and resulted in the communist victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1946年11月22日，国共内战中的吕梁战役开始。国民党军与共产党军队在山西西南部吕梁地区展开一系列战斗，最终共产党军队获胜。这场战役也称晋西南战役。
zh.n: 按来源信息框记载的开始日期收录。

en.s: The Battle of Shuangduiji (双堆集战役) was a major campaign fought between the nationalists and the communists during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era, resulting in a communist victory. The campaign was part of the Huaihai campaign.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1948年11月22日，国共内战中的双堆集战役开始。这场战役是淮海战役的一部分，由国民党军与共产党军队交战，最终共产党军队获胜。

en.s: Dalian Naval Academy (海军大连舰艇学院) is one of the higher education institutes of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy and is located in Dalian, Liaoning. It was established in 1949 as the first naval academy of the Chinese People's Liberation Army and was changed to the current name in 1986. Its address is 667, Jiefang Road, Zhongshan District, Dalian, and is just north of Laohutan (老虎滩), a popular resort place that houses the Dalian Laohutan Ocean Park.

zh.s: 中国人民解放军海军大连舰艇学院（海军大连舰艇学院）是海军高等院校之一，位于辽宁省大连市。学院于1949年成立，是中国人民解放军海军第一所海军院校，1986年改为现名。学院地址为大连市中山区解放路667号，位于热门旅游区老虎滩以北，附近有大连老虎滩海洋公园。

en.s: The Ontario general election of 1951 was held on November 22, 1951, to elect the 90 members of the 24th Legislative Assembly of Ontario (Members of Provincial Parliament, or "MPPs") of the Province of Ontario, Canada. The Ontario Progressive Conservative Party, led by Leslie Frost, won a fourth consecutive term in office, increasing its caucus in the legislature from 53 in the previous election to 79—a solid majority. The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Walter Thomson, lost six seats, but regained the role of official opposition because of the collapse of the CCF vote.

zh.s: 安大略省于1951年11月22日举行大选，选出第24届省议会全部90名议员。莱斯利·弗罗斯特领导的安大略进步保守党连续第四次执政，将党团席位从上届的53席增至79席，取得稳固多数。沃尔特·汤姆森领导的安大略自由党失去6席，但由于合作联邦联盟（CCF）得票崩落，自由党重新成为官方反对党。

en.s: The 1952 Mount Gannett C-124 crash was an accident in which a United States Air Force Douglas C-124 Globemaster II military transport aircraft crashed into Mount Gannett in the Chugach Mountains, Alaska on November 22, 1952. All of the 52 people on board were killed.

zh.s: 1952年11月22日，一架美国空军C-124“环球霸王II”军用运输机在阿拉斯加楚加奇山脉的甘尼特山坠毁。机上52人全部遇难。

en.s: Operation Castor was a successful airborne operation for French Union forces in the First Indochina War. This operation of France and the State of Vietnam established a fortified airhead in Điện Biên Province against the communist Việt Minh, in the north-west corner of Vietnam and was commanded by Brigadier General Jean Gilles. The Operation began at 10:35 on 20 November 1953, with reinforcements dropped over the following two days.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡斯特尔行动是第一次印度支那战争期间法国联盟部队成功实施的一次空降行动。法国和越南国组织这次行动，在奠边省建立设防的空降据点，对抗越盟。行动由准将让·吉勒指挥，于1953年11月20日10时35分开始，随后两天又空投了增援部队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Soviet Union tests RDS-37 thermonuclear bomb at Semipalatinsk
en.s: On November 22, 1955, the Soviet Union tested RDS-37, its first two-stage thermonuclear device, at the Semipalatinsk Test Site in what is now Kazakhstan. A Tu-16 bomber dropped the weapon, which had an estimated yield of about 1.6 megatons. The test was a major step in the Soviet nuclear weapons program.
en.n: RDS-37 was tested on November 22, 1955, at Semipalatinsk.

zh.t: 苏联在塞米巴拉金斯克试验RDS-37氢弹
zh.s: 1955年11月22日，苏联在如今哈萨克斯坦的塞米巴拉金斯克试验场试验RDS-37，这是苏联首个两级热核装置。图-16轰炸机投下炸弹，爆炸当量估计约为160万吨TNT。这次试验是苏联核武器研发的重要一步。
zh.n: RDS-37于1955年11月22日在塞米巴拉金斯克进行试验。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 22 November 1958. All 122 seats in the House of Representatives, and 32 of the 60 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Liberal Party of Australia led by Prime Minister of Australia Robert Menzies with coalition partner the Country Party led by Arthur Fadden defeated the Australian Labor Party led by Herbert Evatt.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1958年11月22日举行联邦大选。众议院全部122个席位和参议院60个席位中的32个席位改选。由总理罗伯特·孟席斯领导的澳大利亚自由党与由阿瑟·法登领导的乡村党组成的执政联盟，击败了由赫伯特·埃瓦特领导的澳大利亚工党。

en.s: The Battle of Hiep Hoa was a minor battle of the Vietnam War. On the night of November 22, 1963, an estimated 500 Vietcong fighters overrun the Hiep Hoa Special Forces Camp, resulting in four American personnel MIA. South Vietnamese commando units and the American special operation forces resisted heavily using machine guns but were overwhelmed by the arrival of a NVA mortar unit. It was the first CIDG camp to be overrun during the war. Isaac Camacho, one of the four missing Americans, later became the first American to escape from a Vietcong POW camp.

zh.s: 协和营地战役是越南战争期间的一场小规模战斗。1963年11月22日晚，估计有500名越共战士攻占协和特种部队营地，造成4名美国人员失踪。南越突击队和美军特种部队使用机枪顽强抵抗，但在北越军队迫击炮部队抵达后被击败。这是战争期间首个被攻占的民众非正规防卫组营地。4名失踪美国人之一艾萨克·卡马乔后来成为首位从越共战俘营逃出的美国人。

en.t: First inauguration of Lyndon B. Johnson
en.s: The first inauguration of Lyndon B. Johnson as the 36th President of the United States was held aboard Air Force One at Love Field in Dallas, Texas, on Friday, November 22, 1963. The inauguration marked the commencement of Johnson's first term (which lasted a year and two months) as President, following the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.

zh.t: 林登·约翰逊首次就职总统
zh.s: 1963年11月22日星期五，林登·约翰逊在达拉斯洛夫球场的空军一号上宣誓就任美国第36任总统，完成首次就职仪式。约翰逊的第一个总统任期由此开始，持续1年零2个月。仪式在约翰·F·肯尼迪总统遇刺后举行。

en.t: 1963 Poonch Indian Air Force helicopter crash
en.s: On Friday, 22 November 1963, an Aérospatiale Alouette III helicopter of the Indian Air Force crashed in Poonch district of Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region. The aircraft was en route to Poonch town, killing all six people on board. Six Indian Armed Forces officers were on board, including three general officers, an air officer and a brigadier.

zh.t: 1963年蓬奇印度空军直升机坠毁事件
zh.s: 1963年11月22日星期五，一架印度空军阿洛埃特III型直升机在有争议的克什米尔地区、印控查谟和克什米尔的蓬奇县坠毁。飞机当时正飞往蓬奇镇，机上6人全部遇难。机上6名印度武装部队军官包括3名将军、一名空军军官和一名准将。

en.t: President John F. Kennedy is assassinated in Dallas
en.s: On November 22, 1963, U.S. President John F. Kennedy was shot while riding in a motorcade through Dealey Plaza in Dallas, Texas. He died later that day at Parkland Memorial Hospital. Vice President Lyndon B. Johnson succeeded him as president. The assassination shocked the United States and drew attention around the world.
en.n: Kennedy was shot and died in Dallas, Texas, on November 22, 1963.

zh.t: 美国总统约翰·肯尼迪在达拉斯遇刺
zh.s: 1963年11月22日，美国总统约翰·肯尼迪的车队经过得克萨斯州达拉斯的迪利广场时，他遭到枪击，随后在帕克兰医院去世。副总统林登·约翰逊继任总统。这起刺杀震惊美国，也引起世界各地关注。
zh.n: 肯尼迪于1963年11月22日在达拉斯遭枪击并去世。

en.s: United Nations Security Council Resolution 242 (S/RES/242) was adopted unanimously by the UN Security Council on 22 November 1967, in the aftermath of the Six-Day War. It was adopted under Chapter VI of the UN Charter. The resolution was sponsored by British ambassador Lord Caradon and was one of five drafts under consideration.

zh.t: 联合国安理会第242号决议
zh.s: 联合国安理会第242号决议（S/RES/242）于1967年11月22日在联合国安理会一致通过，背景是六日战争后的局势。该决议依据《联合国宪章》第六章通过，由英国驻联合国大使卡拉登勋爵提案，当时有5份草案正在审议。

en.s: Japan Air Lines Flight 2 was a scheduled passenger flight on November 22, 1968. The plane was a six-month-old Douglas DC-8-62 named Shiga (志賀), flying from Tokyo International Airport (Haneda) to San Francisco International Airport (SFO). Due to heavy fog and other factors, Captain Kohei Asoh crashed the plane near Coyote Point in the shallow waters of San Francisco Bay, two and a half miles short of the runway.

zh.s: 日本航空2号班机是一趟定期客运航班，于1968年11月22日执行。飞机是一架服役仅6个月的道格拉斯DC-8-62型客机，名为“志贺”号，原定从东京国际机场（羽田）飞往旧金山国际机场。由于浓雾等因素，机长麻生恪二在旧金山湾浅水区、科约特角附近撞毁飞机，地点距跑道约2.5英里。

en.s: Operation Green Sea (Portuguese: Operação Mar Verde), also known as the Battle of Conakry, was an amphibious attack on Conakry, the capital of Guinea, by between 350 and 420 Portuguese soldiers and Portuguese-led Guinean fighters in November 1970.

zh.s: 绿海行动（葡萄牙语：Operação Mar Verde），又称科纳克里战役，是1970年11月由350至420名葡萄牙士兵及葡萄牙领导的几内亚战士对几内亚首都科纳克里发动的一次两栖攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Boyra was a ground and aerial battle that was fought on 22 November 1971 between the India and Pakistan. The Pakistani Army was engaged in combat against the Mukti Bahini (Bengali guerrilla fighters) and a division-sized detachment of the Indian Army during the Battle of Garibpur as part of the Bangladesh Liberation War. Pakistani ground forces requested air cover and close air support from the Pakistan Air Force (PAF).

zh.s: 博伊拉战役是1971年11月22日印度和巴基斯坦之间的一场陆空战。孟加拉解放战争期间，巴基斯坦军队在加里布尔战役中与穆克蒂·巴希尼（孟加拉游击队）和印度陆军一个师规模的分遣队交战。巴基斯坦地面部队随后请求巴基斯坦空军提供空中掩护和近距空中支援。

en.s: The Cairngorm Plateau disaster, also known as the Feith Buidhe disaster, occurred in November 1971 when six fifteen-year-old students from Edinburgh's Ainslie Park High School and their two leaders embarked on a two-day navigational expedition in a remote area of the Cairngorms in the Scottish Highlands. While the group was on the high plateau, the weather deteriorated and so they decided to head for the Curran shelter, a rudimentary refuge.
en.n: In Britain's worst mountaineering tragedy, the Cairngorm Plateau Disaster, five children and one of their leaders are found dead from exposure in the Scottish mountains.

zh.s: 凯恩戈姆高原灾难又称费斯布伊灾难，发生于1971年11月。爱丁堡艾因斯利公园中学的6名15岁学生和两名领队前往苏格兰高地的凯恩戈姆偏远地区，进行为期两天的野外辨向远足。队伍在高原上时天气转坏，于是决定前往简易避难所柯兰小屋。
zh.n: 英国最严重的登山事故中，5名儿童和1名领队被发现死于失温。

en.s: The Drummuckavall ambush was an attack by the South Armagh Brigade of the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) on a British Army observation post in Drummuckavall, southeast of Crossmaglen, County Armagh, on 22 November 1975. The attack, which occurred along the border with the Republic of Ireland, resulted in the deaths of three British soldiers and underlined the inefficiency of conventional military skills to deal with the situation in South Armagh, prompting the deployment of the Special Air Service (SAS) in this area.

zh.t: 德拉姆穆卡瓦尔伏击事件
zh.s: 1975年11月22日，临时爱尔兰共和军南阿马旅袭击了位于阿马郡德拉姆穆卡瓦尔、克罗斯马格伦东南方向的一处英国陆军观察哨。袭击地点靠近爱尔兰共和国边境，造成3名英国士兵死亡。这次袭击凸显了常规军事技能难以应对南阿马局势，促使英国特种空勤团部署到该地区。

en.t: Juan Carlos I is proclaimed King of Spain
en.s: On November 22, 1975, Spain's Cortes proclaimed Juan Carlos I king, two days after the death of Francisco Franco. Juan Carlos took the oath and addressed the Cortes in Madrid. His accession marked the restoration of the Spanish monarchy after Franco's dictatorship; Spain's transition to democracy followed in the years ahead.
en.n: The Cortes proclaimed Juan Carlos king on November 22, 1975; Franco died November 20.

zh.t: 胡安·卡洛斯一世被宣布为西班牙国王
zh.s: 1975年11月22日，弗朗哥去世两天后，西班牙议会宣布胡安·卡洛斯一世为国王。他在马德里宣誓，并向议会发表讲话。西班牙由此恢复君主制，随后几年逐步走向民主转型。
zh.n: 议会于1975年11月22日宣布胡安·卡洛斯为国王；弗朗哥在11月20日去世。

en.s: Starrcade '84: The Million Dollar Challenge was the second annual Starrcade professional wrestling closed-circuit television event that was produced by Jim Crockett Promotions (JCP) under the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) banner. It took place on November 22, 1984, at the Greensboro Coliseum Complex in Greensboro, North Carolina.

zh.s: Starrcade '84：百万美元挑战赛是第二届年度Starrcade职业摔角闭路电视赛事，由吉姆·克罗克特推广公司在全国摔角联盟旗下举办。赛事于1984年11月22日在北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒的格林斯伯勒体育馆综合场馆举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Aruba on 22 November 1985 to elect the Island Council. They were held shortly before Aruba was split from the Netherlands Antilles and obtained the status of a 'land' (country) within the Kingdom of the Netherlands. The Island Council was converted into the first Estates of Aruba on 1 January 1986.

zh.s: 阿鲁巴于1985年11月22日举行大选，选出岛屿议会成员。选举举行前不久，阿鲁巴脱离荷属安的列斯，并在荷兰王国内取得“自治国”的地位。1986年1月1日，岛屿议会改组为阿鲁巴首届议会。

en.t: The Max Headroom signal hijacking incident takes place, in which a pirate broadcast interrupts television broadcasts in Chicago
en.s: On November 22, 1987, two television stations based in Chicago, Illinois, were hijacked two hours apart from one another by unidentified perpetrators. Both hijackings briefly sent pirate broadcasts of an unidentified person wearing a Max Headroom mask and costume to thousands of homes in the Chicago metropolitan area. The first hijacking took place on the independent TV station WGN-TV's nightly newscast.

zh.t: Max Headroom电视信号劫持事件
zh.s: 1987年11月22日，芝加哥两家电视台在相隔两小时内遭到身份不明者劫持信号。劫持者短暂插播了一个戴Max Headroom面具和服装的神秘人物画面，芝加哥都会区数千户家庭收看到了这些节目。首次劫持发生在独立电视台WGN-TV的晚间新闻节目中。

en.s: STS-33 was a NASA Space Shuttle mission and the 9th flight of Discovery, during which Space Shuttle Discovery deployed a payload for the United States Department of Defense (DoD). It was the 32nd shuttle mission overall, the ninth flight of Discovery, the fifth shuttle mission in support of the DoD, the seventh post-Space Shuttle Challenger disaster mission and the last Shuttle mission of the 1980s. Due to the nature of the mission, specific details remain classified. Discovery lifted off from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center (KSC), Florida, on November 22, 1989, at 7:23:30 p.m.

zh.s: STS-33是美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的航天飞机任务，也是“发现号”航天飞机的第9次飞行。任务中，“发现号”将一件载荷送入轨道，服务于美国国防部。它是第32次航天飞机任务、第5次支持国防部的任务，也是“挑战者”号航天飞机失事后的第7次任务，以及20世纪80年代最后一次航天飞机任务。由于任务性质，具体细节仍属机密。“发现号”于1989年11月22日晚上7时23分30秒从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39B发射台升空。

en.s: The 1989 Indian general election in Delhi was held to elect representatives of the 7 seats of the NCT of Delhi in the Lok Sabha. The Bharatiya Janata Party won 4 of the 7 seats in Delhi, with its opposition, the Indian National Congress winning 2 seats, and the Janata Dal at third place with one seat. Although the BJP won most of the seats, the Congress led in terms of votes.

zh.s: 1989年印度大选在德里选出联邦院7个席位的代表。印度人民党赢得4席，印度国民大会党赢得2席，人民党赢得1席。印度人民党席位最多，但国民大会党的总得票数领先。

en.s: Elections to the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in November 1989, to elect members of the 425 constituencies in Uttar Pradesh, India. The Janata Dal won the most seats as well as the popular vote and its leader, Mulayam Singh Yadav was appointed as the new Chief Minister. After the passing of The Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 1976, the number of constituencies in Uttar Pradesh was set as 425.

zh.s: 1989年11月，北方邦举行立法议会选举，选出425个选区的议员。人民党（Janata Dal）赢得最多席位和最多选票，其领袖穆拉亚姆·辛格·亚达夫获任首席部长。1976年划界令将北方邦的选区数定为425。

en.s: The 1989 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly election were held to elect the 9th legislative assembly of Andhra Pradesh. In the 1989 Andhra Pradesh Assembly election, Indian National Congress swept the polls, winning 181 of the 294 seats in the Assembly. As the leader of the Congress Legislature Party, Marri Chenna Reddy was elected the Chief Minister.

zh.s: 1989年安得拉邦举行立法议会选举，选出第九届议会。印度国民大会党大获全胜，在294个席位中赢得181席。该党议会党团领袖马里·钱纳·雷迪当选首席部长。

en.s: The 1990 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the fourth annual Survivor Series and took place on Thanksgiving Day in the United States on Thursday, November 22, 1990, at the Hartford Civic Center in Hartford, Connecticut. The event centered on the Survivor Series match, a tag team elimination match that pits teams of multiple wrestlers against each other.

zh.s: 1990年幸存者大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现WWE）主办的职业摔角付费赛事。这是第4届幸存者大赛，于1990年11月22日美国感恩节当天在康涅狄格州哈特福德的哈特福德市民中心举行。赛事以幸存者大赛为核心，即多名摔角手组成队伍进行淘汰赛。

en.t: Margaret Thatcher withdraws from Conservative leadership contest
en.s: On November 22, 1990, British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher announced that she would not stand in the second ballot of the Conservative Party leadership election. She had led the first ballot but had fallen short of the margin needed to win outright. Thatcher remained prime minister until November 28, when she formally resigned and John Major succeeded her.
en.n: November 22 was the announcement and withdrawal; her formal resignation as prime minister came November 28.

zh.t: 撒切尔夫人退出英国保守党党魁选举
zh.s: 1990年11月22日，英国首相玛格丽特·撒切尔宣布不参加保守党党魁选举的第二轮投票。她在首轮得票领先，但没有达到直接胜出的票数门槛。撒切尔继续担任首相，直到11月28日正式辞职，由约翰·梅杰接任。
zh.n: 11月22日是宣布退出选举的日期；正式辞去首相职务是在11月28日。

en.s: On November 22, 1994, TWA Flight 427, operated using a McDonnell Douglas MD-82, struck a Cessna 441 Conquest II during its take-off roll, killing both of its occupants. The collision took place at St. Louis Lambert International Airport (STL) in Bridgeton, Missouri.

zh.s: 1994年11月22日，环球航空427号班机在起飞滑跑时撞上了一架塞斯纳441“征服者II”型飞机。环球航空班机由麦克唐纳·道格拉斯MD-82执飞，撞击造成塞斯纳飞机上两人死亡。事故发生在密苏里州布里奇顿的圣路易斯兰伯特国际机场。

en.t: U.S. Virgin Islands holds gubernatorial and congressional delegate runoffs
en.s: On November 22, 1994, voters in the U.S. Virgin Islands returned to the polls for runoffs after the November 8 general election. The independent ticket of Roy L. Schneider and Kenneth Mapp won the governor and lieutenant governor race. Independent Victor O. Frazer won the election for delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives.
en.n: The general election was on November 8; the governor and delegate runoffs were on November 22, 1994.

zh.t: 美属维尔京群岛举行州长和国会代表决选
zh.s: 1994年11月22日，美属维尔京群岛举行第二轮投票。此前的11月8日普选中，州长和美国众议院代表选举都没有候选人取得过半数选票。独立参选的罗伊·施奈德和肯尼思·马普当选州长、副州长；维克托·弗雷泽当选美属维尔京群岛驻美国众议院代表。
zh.n: 普选在1994年11月8日举行；州长和众议院代表决选在11月22日举行。

en.t: Sioux Falls holds first mayoral vote under its new city charter
en.s: On November 22, 1994, Sioux Falls, South Dakota, held the first mayoral election under its newly adopted city charter. Seven candidates sought to succeed Mayor Jack White. Jack G. Rentschler and Gary W. Hanson finished first and second in the initial vote and advanced to a December 6 runoff, which Hanson won.
en.n: The initial mayoral vote took place on November 22, 1994; the runoff followed on December 6.

zh.t: 苏福尔斯按新市宪章首次举行市长选举
zh.s: 1994年11月22日，美国南达科他州苏福尔斯市按新通过的市宪章举行首轮市长选举。七名候选人竞逐接替现任市长杰克·怀特。杰克·伦奇勒和加里·汉森得票居前两位，进入12月6日的决选；汉森最终当选。
zh.n: 首轮投票在1994年11月22日举行，决选在12月6日举行。

en.s: The 1997 Ms. Olympia contest was an IFBB professional bodybuilding competition that was held on November 22, 1997, at the Beacon Theatre in New York City, New York. It was the 18th Ms. Olympia competition held.

zh.s: 1997年奥林匹亚女士大赛是国际健美联合会（IFBB）举办的一场职业健美比赛，于1997年11月22日在纽约市的灯塔剧院举行。这是第18届奥林匹亚女士大赛。

en.s: The 1998 World War 3 was the fourth and final World War 3 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on November 22, 1998 from The Palace of Auburn Hills in Auburn Hills, Michigan, the same location as the previous year's event. This event marked the only instance where the traditional World War 3 battle royal did not headline the event.

zh.t: 1998年第三次世界大战摔角赛事
zh.s: 1998年第三次世界大战是世界冠军摔角（WCW）举办的第4届、也是最后一届World War 3职业摔角付费赛事，于1998年11月22日在密歇根州奥本希尔斯的奥本希尔斯宫举行，场地与上一年相同。传统的World War 3大战皇家赛在这届赛事中首次没有成为主赛。

en.s: The Falkland Islands general election of 2001 was held on Thursday 22 November 2001 to elect members to the Legislative Council through universal suffrage using block voting. Chief Executive Michael Blanch acted as Chief Counting Officer. The election took place on the same day as the referendum on merging Stanley and the Camp into a elected by proportional representation. At the start of the campaign the Democratic Association, one of the only political parties in the history of the Falkland Islands, had suggested it would field as many as eight candidates. en.s: General elections were held in Burkina Faso on 22 November 2020 to elect the President and National Assembly. en.s: The 2024 Civic Coalition presidential primary were the third Polish presidential primary election after the 2010 and 2019 primaries for the Civic Platform party. The primary was organized by the coalition following the decision by Donald Tusk not to run for president again (he lost in a runoff to Lech Kaczyński in 2005 and has served as prime minister from 2007 to 2014 and since 2023). Two main candidates emerged: Minister of Foreign Affairs Radosław Sikorski and Mayor of Warsaw, candidate for president in 2020 Rafał Trzaskowski. All parties of the Civic Coalition (Civic Platform, Modern, Polish Initiative, The Greens) were invited to take part in the primaries. The voting took place on 22 November 2024, and the party's nominee, Rafał Trzaskowski, was announced the following day. 22,126 votes were cast in the primary.
